title: Beemaar pa kyu touq o salaasal ki jafa hai
body:
BEEMAR PA KYON TAUQ-O-SALA SAL KI JAFA HAI
SHABBIR KE GHUMQAAR PA HAR ZULM NAYA HAI
AMMU KADI DHOOP KA HAI FARQ KE OOPAR, DURREY KABHI PADTEY HAIN KABHI KHAYE HAIN THOKAR, NAALEY HAIN KAANTAON KI TO KODAON KI ABA HAI, SHABBIR KE GHUMQAAR PA HAR ZULM NAYA HAI
HAI DILBAR-E-MAZLOOM LAYEENAU MEIN GIRAFTAAR, ISDARJEY NAQAYATH HAIKE CHALNA BHI HAI DUSHWAAR, MAA BEHNAOU KE OONTAOU KI RASAN KHAINCH RAHA HAI, SHABBIR KE GHUMQAAR PA HAR ZULM NAYA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
USHTAR SE SAKINA JO GIRI FARSHEY ZAMEEN PAR, NAIZEHY PA WAHIN RUKH GAYA IBNE ALI KA SAR, PHIR ABIDEY BEEMAR PE EK TAAZA JAFA HAI, SHABBIR KE GHUMQAAR PA HAR ZULM NAYA HAI
AALAAM-O-MUSIBATH MEIN BHI HAI SABR-O-SHAKIR, ZAKHMI HAI BADAN KHALB PE HAIN DAAG BAHATAR, OONTAON KI RASAN HAAT MEIN TASBEEH KI JA HAI, SHABBIR KE GHUMQAAR PA HAR ZULM NAYA HAI
BACHHPANN SE JISE SHAH-E-HUDA NAZAON SE PAALEY, US BEKAS-O-MAZLOOM KE PAOUN MEIN HAIN CHALEY, KANTGAON BHARI RAHAON PE GUZAR USKA HUVA HAI, SHABBIR KE GHUMQAAR PA HAR ZULM NAYA HAI
DARBAR MEIN ZALIM KE MUSIBATH KI GHADI HAI, AANKAON SE RAWAN AASHK MUSALSIL KI LADI HAI, SUKHEY HUVE HOTAONPE MAGAR SHUKE-E-KHUDA HAI, SHABBIR KE GHUMQAAR PA HAR ZULM NAYA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
HINDA NE POOCHA JIS GHHADI EHWAAL MUKARRAM, SAJJAD SAR JHUKA KE YEH BOLE BA CHASM-E-NAM, PAANI TO BOHAT DOOR DAWA HAINA GIZA HAI, SHABBIR KE GHUMQAAR PA HAR ZULM NAYA HAI
CHALEEAZ BARAS ROTA RAHA BAAP KE GHAM MEINN, THE SHAAM KE MANZAR JO SADA DEEDAYE NAM MEIN, MAULA KI NIGAHAON MEIN FAQAT KARBOBALA HAI, SHABBIR KE GHUMQAAR PA HAR ZULM NAYA HAI
BABA KE JANAZEY PA KHADEY ROTE HAIN BAQER, PHAT TA HAI JIGAR HAAL PE SAJJAD KE MAZHAR, SADHAIF LAYEENAO NE USE ZAHER DIYA HAI, SHABBIR KE GHUMQAAR PA HAR ZULM NAYA HA
